title: Novelas ejemplares
summary: "Novelas ejemplares" by Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra is a collection of twelve short novels published in 1613. Following the Italian novella tradition, these stories blend idealistic romance with gritty realism, featuring tales of kidnapped noblewomen, young rogues joining a criminal underworld, a scholar who believes he's made of glass, and other colorful characters navigating love, honor, and deception.
